run_transformers_serve_eval: run transformers serve with continuous batching and evaluate a model on GPQA Diamond using inspect-ai
run_transformers_serve_no_cb: run transformers serve without continuous batching and evaluate on GPQA Diamond with inspect-ai
run_transformers_serve_custom_port: run transformers serve with continuous batching on a custom port and evaluate a model
run_transformers_serve_cuda_graph: run transformers serve with continuous batching and CUDA graphs enabled for performance
run_transformers_serve_custom_limit: run transformers serve with continuous batching and limit evaluation to a specific number of samples
